just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on F4 and dwells most on F in Hazin. The line peaks at C5 (505.1 Hz) at 0:25.2. It closes on the tonic (C4 → Ak3 → C5 → Bb3 → C4 → Ak3).
